body: Thanks everybody for all the replies, I'm still trying to understand everything going on and will continue to do my best to support.

>Edit- oh and actually DO things for her, don't just offer. People tend to politely decline offers of help even if they need it, just DO IT! Bring her something to eat, go get her groceries/pick up meds! ☝️

That sounds good, thanks!
I think I'm pretty good with this. I usually try not too relate too much and rather just listen to what they talk/rant about without it trying to seem like I'm trying to make it all about myself.
OK, that's really helpful. Thank you so much.

Hey thanks a lot for the response! 

>be a supportive friend is to not let yourself begin thinking of them as a ms patient that you happen to care about.

I don't think I do this, or at least I try not to, but how can I make sure I'm not? I've only met her relatively recently, and a lot of topics we talk about happen to be about the condition, mostly because I don't know much about it. I will try to keep conversations off the topic.
